pages.title: Bob Brooks for Congress | Put the fire out in Washington
pages.text:
Washington, D.C. is on fire.
## Working people keep getting burned.
Bob Brooks is a firefighter running for Congress to put the fire out and make Washington work for us. Bob has had a lot of jobs – bartender, landscaper, baseball coach, Teamster. He knows Washington needs to do better, and he’s tough enough to get the job done for us.
Bob spent 20 years as a firefighter in the City of Bethlehem. He’s held nearly every position on the truck and every post in his union. As the union President of the Pennsylvania Professional Fire Fighters Association, Bob took on the politicians for higher wages, better healthcare, and benefits for all workers.
Endorsed by Governor Josh Shapiro
Where Bob Stands
End the affordability crisis
Build a fair and sustainable healthcare system
Make the rich pay their taxes
Raise the minimum wage
End and expose government corruption
Bring housing costs down in the Lehigh Valley
Secure the border and build a working immigration system
Power the Lehigh Valley
## Firefighter. Union leader. Family man.

pages.title: Bob's Platform - Bob Brooks for Congress
pages.text:
Bob's Policy Platform
## Washington’s a dumpster fire, and working people are the ones getting burned.
Billionaires and big corporations run the show while the rest of us are left to scrape by. I’ve lived a working-class life. There was a time when a blue-collar job could make you a decent living. It doesn’t anymore.
We’ve fought three wars since the minimum wage was last raised.
The richest 1% of Americans hold 40% of the nation’s wealth while the bottom 50% share just 4%.
Jeff Bezos paid no federal income taxes in 2007 or 2011.
## It’s time to change it.
While Republicans are stripping us for parts, Democrats in Washington need to step up and deliver. That’s why I’m running. I know how hard it is out there right now. I’ve lived it, and I believe we can do better.
I’m here to present the following platform and humbly ask for your support.
## End the affordability crisis.
## Build a fair and sustainable healthcare system.
## Make the rich pay their taxes.
## Raise the minimum wage.
## Strengthen unions.
## Bring housing costs down in the Lehigh Valley.
## Protect social security and retirement benefits.
I’ll always defend Social Security and will sign on to the Medicare and Social Security Fair Share Act, which removes the cap on Social Security Payroll taxes and increases the net investment income tax by 1.2%. While Republicans gut American’s social safety net, I will work to protect the benefits tens of millions have worked hard to earn.
## Cut the cost of childcare.
## Help young people afford college and trade schools.
## End and expose government corruption.
## Secure the border and build a working immigration system.
## Protect local control over the data center industry.
The federal government should never take the power to decide where a data center gets built out of the hands of the residents who have to live near them. I oppose all legislation that hampers local control, like the ten-year ban on state AI regulation Ryan Mackenzie voted for in the One Big Beautiful Bill.
Utility costs are already too high. The last thing we need are data centers raising our energy costs while an out-of-state corporation gets rich.
I'm grateful Governor Shapiro is taking steps like his recent executive order to protect regular Pennsylvanians and allow communities to veto data center proposals in their backyard. We must pass national legislation that makes these protections federal law, and in Congress, that is what I'll fight for.
## Power the Lehigh Valley.
## End gun violence.
## Fund public schools.
## Make our community safer.
## Protect reproductive rights.
We need to codify Roe v. Wade and pass legislation to overturn Trump abortion bans in red states. If you need care, everyone deserves the same access, the same protections, and the same rights.
## Stop bullying LGBTQ people.
## Stop endless wars and support our allies.
Trump weakened our alliances, cozied up to Putin, started a war with Iran, and blocked aid to Ukraine, leaving us less secure on the world stage.
## End the illegal war in Iran.
Ryan Mackenzie promised to end costly wars and bring down your costs. Then he did the opposite.
Five times, he had the chance to end the unauthorized war in Iran. Five times, he voted to keep it going. The result: gas and fertilizer prices spiking, inflation hitting a four-year high, and working families in the Lehigh Valley paying the price for a war that should’ve never been started.
I will always stand against pointless wars that cost American lives and hundreds of billions of taxpayer dollars.
## Serve those who have served our country.
## Modernize transportation around here.
## Fighting for Carbon County.
## Support Bob Brooks for Congress!
## VOTE Bob Brooks for Congress.
